name: Francisco, Fowl Marauder
oracle_text:
Flying
Francisco can't block.
Whenever one or more Pirates you control deal damage to a player, Francisco explores.
Partner (You can have two commanders if both have partner.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more Pirates you control deal damage to a player, Francisco explores.

needs.what: a 'whenever one or more <filter> you control deal damage to a player' trigger over ANY damage (combat and noncombat), batched across every matching source in one simultaneous damage event (a combat damage step, or one effect op), firing once per batch -- e.g. `batched: true` accepted on `deals_damage_to_player` (adding it to `BATCHED_EVENTS`, grouped by the `batch` that `damage_player` stamps), with `filter: {"subtypes": ["Pirate"]}` and `controller: "you"`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `creatures_deal_combat_damage` has the right one-or-more batching and a `filter` over the damagers but is combat damage only, so a Pirate's noncombat damage (a pinger, a burn trigger) would be missed -- a narrower card. `deals_damage_to_player` hears noncombat damage but is keyed per source: two Pirates connecting in the same combat damage step would fire twice and make Francisco explore twice, and `batched` is refused there because it is not in `BATCHED_EVENTS`. The effect (`explore` with `objects: {"self_only": true}`) and the 'can't block' static (`cant_block` on self) are expressible; only the trigger is missing
